title: Cut nail's serial overhead around seeding and setup
body:
A 481.8 s search run of all Pfam against one MGnify recall shard (2,455,940 targets, 48 threads) with the new -s runtime tree shows every serial second nail spends: 30 s in total, 6.2% of the run. Two items are 72% of that and have known fixes: the mmseqs target db write (15.5 s) and the profile parse in build_pipeline (6.2 s). Everything else serial sums to 1.7%. The tree and the analysis are in the notes.

Blocked on the libsail evaluation: Jack wants to decide whether libsail takes over parsing and indexing of inputs before any of the parsing-side work is touched, since that would replace the code these fixes would change.

Not a goal: caching the target db across runs. It only helps repeated runs, which do not matter here.
